verses.en: My little children, these things write I unto you, that ye sin not. And if any man sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous:
verses.pt: Meus filhinhos, estas coisas vos escrevo, para que não pequeis; mas, se alguém pecar, temos um Advogado para com o Pai, Jesus Cristo, o justo.
verses.en_web: My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the Father, Jesus Christ, the righteous.
verses.en_bbe: My little children, I am writing these things to you so that you may be without sin. And if any man is a sinner, we have a friend and helper with the Father, Jesus Christ, the upright one:

verses.en: And he is the propitiation for our sins: and not for ours only, but also for the sins of the whole world.
verses.pt: E ele é a propiciação pelos nossos pecados, e não somente pelos nossos, mas também pelos de todo o mundo.
verses.en_web: And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.
verses.en_bbe: He is the offering for our sins; and not for ours only, but for all the world.

verses.en: And hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.
verses.pt: E nisto sabemos que o conhecemos; se guardamos os seus mandamentos.
verses.en_web: This is how we know that we know him: if we keep his commandments.
verses.en_bbe: And by this we may be certain that we have knowledge of him, if we keep his laws.

verses.en: He that saith, I know him, and keepeth not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him.
verses.pt: Aquele que diz: Eu o conheço, e não guarda os seus mandamentos, é mentiroso, e nele não está a verdade;
verses.en_web: One who says, “I know him,” and doesn’t keep his commandments, is a liar, and the truth isn’t in him.
verses.en_bbe: The man who says, I have knowledge of him, and does not keep his laws, is false, and there is nothing true in him:

verses.en: But whoso keepeth his word, in him verily is the love of God perfected: hereby know we that we are in him.
verses.pt: mas qualquer que guarda a sua palavra, nele realmente se tem aperfeiçoado o amor de Deus. E nisto sabemos que estamos nele;
verses.en_web: But whoever keeps his word, God’s love has most certainly been perfected in him. This is how we know that we are in him:
verses.en_bbe: But in every man who keeps his word, the love of God is made complete. By this we may be certain that we are in him:

verses.en: He that saith he abideth in him ought himself also so to walk, even as he walked.
verses.pt: aquele que diz estar nele, também deve andar como ele andou.
verses.en_web: he who says he remains in him ought himself also to walk just like he walked.
verses.en_bbe: He who says that he is living in him, will do as he did.

verses.en: Brethren, I write no new commandment unto you, but an old commandment which ye had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which ye have heard from the beginning.
verses.pt: Amados, não vos escrevo mandamento novo, mas um mandamento antigo, que tendes desde o princípio. Este mandamento antigo é a palavra que ouvistes.
verses.en_web: Brothers, I write no new commandment to you, but an old commandment which you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you heard from the beginning.
verses.en_bbe: My loved ones, I do not give you a new law, but an old law which you had from the first; this old law is the word which came to your ears.

verses.en: Again, a new commandment I write unto you, which thing is true in him and in you: because the darkness is past, and the true light now shineth.
verses.pt: Contudo é um novo mandamento que vos escrevo, o qual é verdadeiro nele e em vós; porque as trevas vão passando, e já brilha a verdadeira luz.
verses.en_web: Again, I write a new commandment to you, which is true in him and in you; because the darkness is passing away, and the true light already shines.
verses.en_bbe: Again, I give you a new law, which is true in him and in you; for the night is near its end and the true light is even now shining out.

verses.en: He that saith he is in the light, and hateth his brother, is in darkness even until now.
verses.pt: Aquele que diz estar na luz, e odeia a seu irmão, até agora está nas trevas.
verses.en_web: He who says he is in the light and hates his brother, is in the darkness even until now.
verses.en_bbe: He who says that he is in the light, and has hate in his heart for his brother, is still in the dark.

verses.en: He that loveth his brother abideth in the light, and there is none occasion of stumbling in him.
verses.pt: Aquele que ama a seu irmão permanece na luz, e nele não há tropeço.
verses.en_web: He who loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no occasion for stumbling in him.
verses.en_bbe: He who has love for his brother is in the light, and there is no cause of error in him.

verses.en: But he that hateth his brother is in darkness, and walketh in darkness, and knoweth not whither he goeth, because that darkness hath blinded his eyes.
verses.pt: Mas aquele que odeia a seu irmão está nas trevas, e anda nas trevas, e não sabe para onde vai; porque as trevas lhe cegaram os olhos.
verses.en_web: But he who hates his brother is in the darkness, and walks in the darkness, and doesn’t know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.
verses.en_bbe: But he who has hate for his brother is in the dark, walking in the dark with no knowledge of where he is going, unable to see because of the dark.

verses.en: I write unto you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.
verses.pt: Filhinhos, eu vos escrevo, porque os vossos pecados são perdoados por amor do seu nome.
verses.en_web: I write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.
verses.en_bbe: I am writing to you, my children, because you have forgiveness of sins through his name.

verses.en: I write unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I write unto you, young men, because ye have overcome the wicked one. I write unto you, little children, because ye have known the Father.
verses.pt: Pais, eu vos escrevo, porque conheceis aquele que é desde o princípio. Jovens, eu vos escrevo, porque vencestes o Maligno.
verses.en_web: I write to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I write to you, little children, because you know the Father.
verses.en_bbe: I am writing to you, fathers, because you have knowledge of him who was from the first. I am writing to you, young men, because you have overcome the Evil One. I have sent a letter to you, children, because you have knowledge of the Father.

verses.en: I have written unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I have written unto you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abideth in you, and ye have overcome the wicked one.
verses.pt: Eu vos escrevi, meninos, porque conheceis o Pai. Eu vos escrevi, pais, porque conheceis aquele que é desde o princípio. Eu escrevi, jovens, porque sois fortes, e a palavra de Deus permanece em vós, e já vencestes o Maligno.
verses.en_web: I have written to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God remains in you, and you have overcome the evil one.
verses.en_bbe: I have sent a letter to you, fathers, because you have knowledge of him who was from the first. I have sent a letter to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God is in you, and because you have overcome the Evil One.

verses.en: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
verses.pt: Não ameis o mundo, nem o que há no mundo. Se alguém ama o mundo, o amor do Pai não está nele.
verses.en_web: Don’t love the world or the things that are in the world. If anyone loves the world, the Father’s love isn’t in him.
verses.en_bbe: Have no love for the world or for the things which are in the world. If any man has love for the world, the love of the Father is not in him.

verses.en: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.
verses.pt: Porque tudo o que há no mundo, a concupiscência da carne, a concupiscência dos olhos e a soberba da vida, não vem do Pai, mas sim do mundo.
verses.en_web: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, isn’t the Father’s, but is the world’s.
verses.en_bbe: Because everything in the world, the desire of the flesh, the desire of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father but of the world.

verses.en: And the world passeth away, and the lust thereof: but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever.
verses.pt: Ora, o mundo passa, e a sua concupiscência; mas aquele que faz a vontade de Deus, permanece para sempre.
verses.en_web: The world is passing away with its lusts, but he who does God’s will remains forever.
verses.en_bbe: And the world and its desires is coming to an end: but he who does God's pleasure is living for ever.

verses.en: Little children, it is the last time: and as ye have heard that antichrist shall come, even now are there many antichrists; whereby we know that it is the last time.
verses.pt: Filhinhos, esta é a última hora; e, conforme ouvistes que vem o anticristo, já muitos anticristos se têm levantado; por onde conhecemos que é a última hora.
verses.en_web: Little children, these are the end times, and as you heard that the Antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have arisen. By this we know that it is the final hour.
verses.en_bbe: Little children, it is the last hour; and as you were given word that the Antichrist would come, so now a number of Antichrists have come to you; and by this we are certain that it is the last hour.

verses.en: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would no doubt have continued with us: but they went out, that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us.
verses.pt: Saíram dentre nós, mas não eram dos nossos; porque, se fossem dos nossos, teriam permanecido conosco; mas todos eles saíram para que se manifestasse que não são dos nossos.
verses.en_web: They went out from us, but they didn’t belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have continued with us. But they left, that they might be revealed that none of them belong to us.
verses.en_bbe: They went out from us but they were not of us; if they had been of us they would still be with us: but they went out from us so that it might be made clear that they were not of us.

verses.en: But ye have an unction from the Holy One, and ye know all things.
verses.pt: Ora, vós tendes a unção da parte do Santo, e todos tendes conhecimento.
verses.en_web: You have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all have knowledge.
verses.en_bbe: And you have the Spirit from the Holy One and you all have knowledge.

verses.en: I have not written unto you because ye know not the truth, but because ye know it, and that no lie is of the truth.
verses.pt: Não vos escrevi porque não soubésseis a verdade, mas porque a sabeis, e porque nenhuma mentira vem da verdade.
verses.en_web: I have not written to you because you don’t know the truth, but because you know it, and because no lie is of the truth.
verses.en_bbe: I have not sent you this letter because you have no knowledge of what is true, but because you have knowledge, and because that which is false has nothing in common with that which is true.

verses.en: Who is a liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ? He is antichrist, that denieth the Father and the Son.
verses.pt: Quem é o mentiroso, senão aquele que nega que Jesus é o Cristo? Esse mesmo é o anticristo, esse que nega o Pai e o Filho.
verses.en_web: Who is the liar but he who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the Antichrist, he who denies the Father and the Son.
verses.en_bbe: Who is false but he who says that Jesus is not the Christ? He is the Antichrist who has no belief in the Father or the Son.

verses.en: Whosoever denieth the Son, the same hath not the Father: (but) he that acknowledgeth the Son hath the Father also.
verses.pt: Qualquer que nega o Filho, também não tem o Pai; aquele que confessa o Filho, tem também o Pai.
verses.en_web: Whoever denies the Son, the same doesn’t have the Father. He who confesses the Son has the Father also.
verses.en_bbe: He who has no belief in the Son has not the Father: he who makes clear his belief in the Son has the Father.

verses.en: Let that therefore abide in you, which ye have heard from the beginning. If that which ye have heard from the beginning shall remain in you, ye also shall continue in the Son, and in the Father.
verses.pt: Portanto, o que desde o princípio ouvistes, permaneça em vós. Se em vós permanecer o que desde o princípio ouvistes, também vós permanecereis no Filho e no Pai.
verses.en_web: Therefore, as for you, let that remain in you which you heard from the beginning. If that which you heard from the beginning remains in you, you also will remain in the Son, and in the Father.
verses.en_bbe: But as for you, keep in your hearts the things which were made clear to you from the first. If you keep these things in your hearts you will be kept in the Father and the Son.

verses.en: And this is the promise that he hath promised us, even eternal life.
verses.pt: E esta é a promessa que ele nos fez: a vida eterna.
verses.en_web: This is the promise which he promised us, the eternal life.
verses.en_bbe: And this is the hope which he gave you, even eternal life.

verses.en: These things have I written unto you concerning them that seduce you.
verses.pt: Estas coisas vos escrevo a respeito daqueles que vos querem enganar.
verses.en_web: These things I have written to you concerning those who would lead you astray.
verses.en_bbe: I am writing these things to you about those whose purpose is that you may be turned out of the true way.

verses.en: But the anointing which ye have received of him abideth in you, and ye need not that any man teach you: but as the same anointing teacheth you of all things, and is truth, and is no lie, and even as it hath taught you, ye shall abide in him.
verses.pt: E quanto a vós, a unção que dele recebestes fica em vós, e não tendes necessidade de que alguém vos ensine; mas, como a sua unção vos ensina a respeito de todas as coisas, e é verdadeira, e não é mentira, como vos ensinou ela, assim nele permanecei.
verses.en_web: As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you don’t need for anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, you will remain in him.
verses.en_bbe: As for you, the Spirit which he gave you is still in you, and you have no need of any teacher; but as his Spirit gives you teaching about all things, and is true and not false, so keep your hearts in him, through the teaching which he has given you.

verses.en: And now, little children, abide in him; that, when he shall appear, we may have confidence, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
verses.pt: E agora, filhinhos, permanecei nele; para que, quando ele se manifestar, tenhamos confiança, e não fiquemos confundidos diante dele na sua vinda.
verses.en_web: Now, little children, remain in him, that when he appears, we may have boldness, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
verses.en_bbe: And now, my children, keep your hearts in him; so that at his revelation, we may have no fear or shame before him at his coming.

verses.en: If ye know that he is righteous, ye know that every one that doeth righteousness is born of him.
verses.pt: Se sabeis que ele é justo, sabeis que todo aquele que pratica a justiça é nascido dele.
verses.en_web: If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of him.
verses.en_bbe: If you have knowledge that he is upright, it is clear to you that everyone who does righteousness is his offspring.
